name: Self-hosted sandboxed personal AI chief of staff

mentions.name: Self-hosted sandboxed personal AI chief of staff
mentions.description: A sandboxed, self-hosted environment for running open weight AI models over a copy of the user's personal data (email, docs, messaging, photos), acting as an AI "chief of staff" with full read access to personal information.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a simple sandboxed way to run open weight models over a copy of all my personal data (email, docs, messaging, photos, etc). Think it'd be cool to have a self hosted AI "chief of staff" that has full read access to my personal info.

evidence.value: Building a simple sandboxed way to run open weight models over a copy of all my personal data (email, docs, messaging, photos, etc). Think it'd be cool to have a self hosted AI "chief of staff" that has full read access to my personal info.
